{{Quote|They're so busy hiding behind treaties, they're handing out credits like candy. I mean, folks like you and me can make a killing.|Numen Brock|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Numen Brock''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who became a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] privateer during the [[Galactic War]]. He was given the rank of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] and was working with the [[Balmorran resistance]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]

==Biography==
Numen Brock was initially a hired man by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who was given the rank of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] and joined the [[Balmorran resistance]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. He operated as a cryptographic analysis specialist overseeing all encoded Republic Communications in the planet and also the main contact of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service|SIS]] double-agent [[Tyrak|Golden]]. Numen was the owner of the droid [[C-6RR|Sixer]] that was stationed in [[Farnel Outpost]] during the start of the [[Galactic War]].

In [[3642 BBY]], Brock served as the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] known as [[Voidhound]]'s contact when the latter came to Balmorra to disrupt [[Project Nebula]], an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] operation focused in developing advanced weaponry. Brock proceeded to assign the smuggler to retrieve new info from Golden in Imperial territory. He was eventually captured by the Imperials during a patrol, but was [[Mission to Camp Vigil|rescued]] from [[Camp Vigil]] by the Voidhound.

==Behind the scenes==
Numen Brock can be romanced by the female Smuggler.
